cursor.description: Opaque continuation returned by the same tool and unchanged query; do not edit it.
cursor.title: Cursor

glob.description: Filename glob applied below path, for example **/*.py.
glob.title: Glob

path.description: Directory relative to project root or scope_path; empty is root.
path.title: Path

project_id.description: Opaque project ID returned by projects_list; never send a local path.
project_id.title: Project Id

purpose.description: Concise user-facing reason shown in Windows approval and local activity history.
purpose.title: Purpose

recursive.description: Whether to recursively traverse descendants below path.
recursive.title: Recursive

scope_path.description: Optional requested absolute Windows directory outside the project, e.g. C:/Temp. Local project policy and Windows approval still apply; not a trust assertion.
scope_path.title: Scope Path
